convert_sana_controlnet_checkpoint: run the CLI script to convert a Sana ControlNet checkpoint to Diffusers format with --orig_ckpt_path and --dump_path
convert_sana_controlnet_1600m: convert a SanaMS 1600M ControlNet checkpoint to Diffusers format using the default model type and fp16 dtype
convert_sana_controlnet_600m: convert a SanaMS 600M ControlNet checkpoint to Diffusers format by setting --model_type to SanaMS_600M_P1_ControlNet_D7
convert_sana_controlnet_custom_image_siz: convert a Sana ControlNet checkpoint with a custom image size like 2048 or 4096 using --image_size
convert_sana_controlnet_bf16: convert a Sana ControlNet checkpoint to Diffusers format with bf16 precision using --dtype bf16
